findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Weak PRNG for ID generation
 * @description Using random module for ID generation is cryptographically weak
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/weak-prng
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-338
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["random", "randint", "randrange", "choice", "choices", "getrandbits"]).getACall()
select call, "Usage of weak PRNG from random module."
findings.hypothesis: The package uses the weak 'random' module for generating IDs or other sensitive values instead of a CSPRNG.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Hardcoded secret
 * @description Hardcoded credentials in source code
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/hardcoded-secret
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-798
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::Node node
where
  (
    node.asExpr().(StrConst).getText().regexpMatch("(?i).*(password|secret|apikey|token|auth).*") and
    not node.asExpr().(StrConst).getText().regexpMatch("(?i).*(example|test|placeholder).*") and
    node.asExpr().(StrConst).getText().length() > 10
  )
select node, "Possible hardcoded secret."
findings.hypothesis: Hardcoded credentials might be present in the source code.
